Verified on hardware (Pico 2 + DVI Sock) by the user.

Done for RP2350: TinyUSB host keyboard verified by the user on Pico 2 + DVI Sock (typing, bidirectional serial). RP2040 Feather crashed with it; USB_KEYBOARD defaults OFF there, follow-up in dmt.20.

Not viable: 800x600 runs clk_sys at 400 MHz, not a multiple of 12 MHz as Pico-PIO-USB needs, and it would cost more CPU/RAM than the native controller on the RP2040 that already failed (dmt.20). The native-port keyboard (dmt.5) covers RP2350.
